decisions.subject: R-JY: start counts and before-image keys come from the compute; the link plan is the join target writing the null-retract target's declared columns; the inheritance write is a later opt-in arm
decisions.recommendation: Q1: two pure compute exports, as buildCumulativeSql already is in runCascadePhase: buildStartCountsSql(descriptor) (the runner copies the keys it returns) and a before-image row mapper keyed by the set_based_null_retract target's declared columns[].name; no descriptor field (CHAT-108), nothing positional (CHAT-139); link_wsib's compute returns today's statements, byte-identical, proven by its retaken captures (#39). Q2: the link plan is the set_based_join_update on the cascade table whose declared column names equal the null-retract target's column names; zero or more than one match is refused before any write (operator confirmed this name-equality reading under CHAT-139). Any other join target on that table (link_coa's lat/long/ward inheritance, legacy link-coa.js:580-686, its own transaction after the tiers) is a separate post-link arm, refused until its own card is ruled (R-EG every arm opt-in; CHAT-108 anything new comes back as a card). Changes: scripts/lib/step/index.js and scripts/lib/compute/link-wsib.js in the R-JY patch, the cascade row of Spec 132 table 1a, test C4 made real, C3 rewritten.
